q: How do I calculate a homestay's carbon footprint per guest night?
title: Homestay carbon per guest night
short: Add electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, LPG at 2.98 kg CO2 per kg, and diesel for any backup, then divide by guest nights. Separate the family's own use where meters allow, or allocate by rooms occupied by guests.
audience: Homestay owners and rural tourism operators

p: CO2 from burning firewood is biogenic and reported separately. Methane and nitrous oxide from burning it are counted.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
